title: Analytics
description: Track revenue, orders, inventory, and cart activity.

help.title: About Analytics
help.overview: Analytics summarizes paid revenue, orders, inventory, and carts for this company. It is a read of those records. Nothing on this page creates an order, a product, or a stock change.

sections.title: What the period changes
sections.body: The period is 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or 1 year. It does not apply to every card.
items: Revenue, order counts, and product counts follow the period.
The daily revenue chart is paid revenue per day inside that period.
Inventory and abandoned carts are the current picture. Changing the period does not recompute them.

sections.title: The money and order cards
sections.body: These count paid orders, not every order that was placed.
items: Total revenue is paid orders in the period.
Orders is the number of those paid orders.
Average order value is that revenue divided by that count.

sections.title: The stock and cart cards
sections.body: These are current, so they can disagree with the period you have selected. That is expected.
items: Abandoned carts are carts inactive for more than an hour.
Low stock is a SKU under its reorder point. Out of stock is a SKU with nothing available.
Units on hand is the total inventory quantity. Products is the catalog counted by status.
Open Inventory, Product orders, or Products when a card is the thing you need to act on.

errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching dashboard data.
noChartData: No revenue data for this period.
